title: Rebuild triggers — Index Rebuild Scheduler
description:
The index rebuild scheduler decides when an index needs rebuilding, plans the rebuild to avoid disrupting live traffic, and executes it safely — full or incremental, online or offline. Rebuilds are expensive and risky; the scheduler weighs staleness against cost, picks low-traffic windows, builds the new index alongside the old, and flips traffic only after verification. It turns 'rebuild the index' from a scary manual operation into routine maintenance.

This record documents the rebuild triggers approach: Fire rebuilds on staleness thresholds, corruption detection, schema change, or manual request.
